role: Product Manager · Lead UI/UX Designer · Product Owner

Lead sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews and retrospectives as both product decision-maker and design lead.
Build and maintain the shared design system (components, typography, colour, accessibility) that keeps the apps consistent.
